title: ReadCode pilot: finding problems in code you didn't write
consent: This is a research pilot for ReadCode, a tool for practising and measuring how well people find problems in unfamiliar code. It takes about 60 to 90 minutes in one sitting.
We record your answers, how long each task takes, and the background answers you give next. We do not record your name or email with your answers; your participant code is the only link.

Your results are never used to make a hiring decision about you, and are only reported as group statistics. You can stop at any time, and you can ask us to delete your answers using your participant code.
Please do not use AI assistants or web search during the tasks. At the end we will ask whether you did; answering honestly does not affect anything.

survey.label: Years working as a software engineer (not counting internships)
Have you been on call for a production service?
How comfortable are you reading Python? (1 = barely, 5 = daily)
Have you worked on the Saleor codebase?

honesty.label: Did you use an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot...) during any task?
Did you search the web for any task?
Were you interrupted or did you take a long break during a task?
Anything that was confusing or felt unfair? (optional)
